--
Part of #325 / #295.

`reportUnknownMemberType` is off for pure Reflex-markup directories via `executionEnvironments`, but some files mix Reflex UI calls (which produce unfixable 'partially unknown' findings from Reflex's stubs) with ordinary logic. Those files currently carry a file-level `# pyright: reportUnknownMemberType=false` pragma, which also hides real findings in their non-Reflex code.

Split them so the Reflex parts live in path-excludable modules and the logic stays checked. Known files: `app/www/wrapper.py`, `app/www/style.py`, `app/export.py`, plus Reflex render calls in `tests/`.

result.output: **Dependency map (verified on `main`)** — makes the split mechanical: - `app/www/style.py` — logic consumers: `app/www/generator.py` imports `HeadingIdRegistry` + `iter_heading_segments`; `app/www/parser.py` imports those plus `markdown_component_map`, `render_heading`, `render_parse_error`; tests import `markdown_component_map`/`render_pre` (`test_render_pre.py`, `test_style.py`, `test_external_links.py`, `test_heading_id_dedup.py`). - `app/www/wrapper.py` — exactly one pure-logic symbol, `generate_component_id`, imported by `app/examples/utils.py` and `app/templates/toc.py`; everything else is `rx.*` markup consumed by `app/www/parser.py` and tests. - `app/export.py` — consumed only by `app/app.py` (`export_site`); its logic content is the docs-loop title/meta string handling. **Plan** 1. **Order and re-baseline** — land #322/#323/#324 first, then re-probe with the pinned pyright (1.1.414), chunked per top-level dir and backgrounded (`app/www/style.py` alone can exceed 12 min). The ~130 real findings include untyped `list.append`/`sort` sites in `app/www/*` that #323 will already have fixed — never plan from the 2178 baseline. Use the re-probe to enumerate *all* mixed files rather than trusting the three known ones (`app/www/parser.py` also builds components alongside AST logic). 2. **Split `app/www/style.py`** — move the render half (`render_*` functions, `markdown_component_map`, the class-string constants) to a new markup module (e.g. `app/www/markdown_render.py`); keep `slugify`, `HeadingIdRegistry`, `iter_heading_segments` checked. Update the importer sites listed above. 3. **Split `app/www/wrapper.py`** — move `generate_component_id` into a small checked module (e.g. `app/www/ids.py`); the remaining wrapper builders are pure markup and the file becomes path-excludable. 4. **Split `app/export.py`** — extract a pure page-spec module (route/title/meta per page, including the docs-loop string handling) and treat the `add_page` calls plus the 404 `rx.el` markup as markup. Since `executionEnvironments` roots are directories, either move `export_site` under a carved-out dir (e.g. `app/pages/`) leaving `app/export.py` a checked shim, or move the 404 markup into an excludable module. 5. **Tests** — the render calls are the test subject, so the pragmatic option is one `executionEnvironments` entry with root `tests` and the rule `"none"` (the 98 real test findings shrink after #323/#324). Concentrating `rx.el` call sites in an excludable helper module is the stricter fallback if test-logic findings emerge. 6. **Wire the config** — in `configs/pyrightconfig.json`, set the rule to `"error"` globally with `"none"` overrides per markup root (candidates: `app/pages`, `app/templates`, `app/examples`, `app/anatomy_src`, `app/www/library`, plus the new markup modules' locations). Mechanics verified in #325's thread still apply: trunk passes each file to pyright explicitly, so `exclude` is not the tool; `"warning"` silences nothing under trunk (warning→medium still fails the new-issue scan) — carve-outs must be `"none"`, the global restore `"error"`. Run the pinned pyright and read stderr to confirm it honors the nested-root overrides and drops no key silently. 7. **Land split + flip together** — trunk's scan comparison gates *relocated* code as new once the rule is on, so do the file moves and the config flip in the same PR (the upstream base scan runs with HEAD's config), fixing the checked-module residue in that PR.   ｜ [Implement a fix ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/elviskahoro/buridan-ui/327?action=build) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/elviskahoro/buridan-ui/actions/runs/42089234431/job/127462571724) ｜ via [Pullfrog](https://pullfrog.com) ｜ Using `glm-5p3-flash` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai) -- configs/pyrightconfig.json:25: "reportUnknownMemberType": "none", 554 app/www/wrapper.py 376 app/www/style.py 115 app/export.py 1045 total

def iter_heading_segments(text: str) -> Iterator[tuple[str, Any]]:
    """Yield ``('heading', (level, text))`` and ``('text', body)`` segments.

    Splits a markdown chunk at every h1/h2 (``#`` / ``##``) line so the parser
    can render headings server-side with pre-computed DOM ids (see
    :class:`HeadingIdRegistry`) and feed only the prose between them to
    ``rx.markdown``.

    Code-fence aware: ``#``-lines inside a fenced code block (``` or ~~~) are
    treated as code, not headings — so a ``#``-comment in a fenced code block
    never becomes a phantom section. This matches how ``rx.markdown`` (via
    remark) parses the surrounding prose, keeping the TOC extractor and the
    rendered DOM in lock-step on exactly the same set of headings.
    """
    lines = text.split("\n")
    in_fence = False
    fence_marker = ""
    buf: list[str] = []

    def flush() -> Iterator[tuple[str, str]]:
        if buf:
            yield ("text", "\n".join(buf))
            buf.clear()

    for line in lines:
        stripped = line.lstrip()
        starts_fence = stripped.startswith(("```", "~~~"))

        if not in_fence and starts_fence:
            in_fence = True
            fence_marker = stripped[:3]
            buf.append(line)
            continue

        if in_fence and stripped.startswith(fence_marker):
            in_fence = False
            fence_marker = ""
            buf.append(line)
            continue

        if in_fence:
            buf.append(line)
            continue

        heading_match = _HEADING_RE.match(line)
        if heading_match:
            yield from flush()
            level = len(heading_match.group(1))
            yield ("heading", (level, heading_match.group(2).strip()))
            continue

        buf.append(line)

    yield from flush()

content.text:
I opened PR #334, but it only covers part of issue #327. I couldn't run pytest or pyright because the sandbox has no Reflex install or `.venv`. Only ruff's import-sorting and unused-name checks ran, and they pass.

**Done:**
- `generate_component_id` now lives in a new `app/www/ids.py`. `app/examples/utils.py` and `app/templates/toc.py` import it from there.
- The render half of `app/www/style.py` moved to a new `app/www/markdown_render.py`. `style.py` keeps `slugify`, `HeadingIdRegistry` and `iter_heading_segments` as plain logic.
- `app/www/parser.py` and three test files (`test_external_links.py`, `test_render_pre.py`, `test_style.py`) import from the new locations.

**Not done:**
- Splitting `app/export.py`.
- The `tests/` carve-out.
- The `configs/pyrightconfig.json` flip. `reportUnknownMemberType` is still `"none"` globally, so nothing is path-excluded yet. The issue says to do the moves and the flip in the same PR. Doing that needs the pinned pyright 1.1.414, which can run over 12 minutes on `style.py`.

The file-level `# pyright: reportUnknownMemberType=false` pragmas the issue mentions aren't in the repo on this branch, so there was nothing to remove.
